items.period: Shang oracle script style (period label of the modern redraw; no artifact date asserted)
items.caption: A modern vector redraw labeled as 五 in Shang oracle script style; it illustrates an early-script form without resolving the graph’s disputed origin.
items.alt: Modern vector drawing identified by its Commons page as 五 in Shang oracle script style.
items.selection_reason: Provides a candidate early-script form useful for comparing with the later seal-script redraw; the paleographic source says original meaning is unknown.
items.rights: Commons page states CC0 1.0 for the Sinica Database glyph image and labels the vector representation public domain.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script style (period label of the modern redraw; no artifact date asserted)
items.caption: A modern vector redraw labeled as 五 in Shuowen seal-script style, representing the later dictionary tradition rather than an excavated inscription.
items.alt: Modern vector drawing identified by its Commons page as 五 in Shuowen seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: Pairs with the oracle-style candidate to illustrate script-tradition comparison; the source does not support reading the seal form as proof of origin.
items.rights: Commons page identifies permission/courtesy from Richard Sears and marks the representation public domain.

limitations.text: Both selected candidates are modern vector redraws, not ancient artifact photographs. Web retrieval of each exact original image URL failed with cache miss; identity, labels, provenance and rights were checked on the respective Commons pages.
